text_block_list.text: I'm discussing the day's training schedule with Narita Brian, when…

text_block_list.name: Novelist
text_block_list.text: Just as I thought… You're the perfect subject for my novel!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: …And who are you exactly?

text_block_list.name: Novelist
text_block_list.text: I'm a novelist. I've received permission to come perform research for my next novel!
choice_data_list: You want to base it on Brian?

text_block_list.name: Novelist
text_block_list.text: Yes! It's the story of an overwhelmingly powerful Umamusume who is reborn in a fantasy world…

text_block_list.name: Brian Reborn
text_block_list.text: You thought you could outrun these legs? I may have reincarnated, but I'm still an Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Brian Reborn
text_block_list.text: Now, make my day! Draw your sword—face me and fight!

text_block_list.name: Novelist
text_block_list.text: See? You're perfect for the part of a hero!

text_block_list.name: Novelist
text_block_list.text: So please allow me to interview you for this surefire masterpiece!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I've got nothing to talk about. You're interrupting my training.

text_block_list.name: Novelist
text_block_list.text: Ugh! …Trainer! Can I at least observe the training session?
choice_data_list: I guess you can watch from the side…

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Hmph… Let's go already.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Phew… And that's three sets of fifty.

text_block_list.name: Novelist
text_block_list.text: I see. If you can lift that much, then I suppose I should use a long sword or an axe for the weapon.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: That's it for the warm-up. Let's double up the weight.

text_block_list.name: Novelist
text_block_list.text: What?! Double?! …Th-that's… quite extraordinary…

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Huff… Huff… And that's five laps.

text_block_list.name: Novelist
text_block_list.text: So she can run five laps around the track? Just as I thought! I'll reference it in the—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I'm going to take off the ankle weights and do three more laps.

text_block_list.name: Novelist
text_block_list.text: Whaaat?! You were wearing ankle weights?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: …Phew.

text_block_list.name: Novelist
text_block_list.text: Amazing… So this is the real Narita Brian…

text_block_list.name: Novelist
text_block_list.text: I don't know if I'd say helpful… More like shocking. I've created a variety of protagonists before, but…

text_block_list.name: Novelist
text_block_list.text: They all pale in comparison next to what I've seen today. Her drive surpasses any fiction!

text_block_list.name: Novelist
text_block_list.text: I want to write her as she really is! A novel with the real Brian as the main character!
choice_data_list: What happened to the fantasy novel?

text_block_list.name: Novelist
text_block_list.text: I… I can't stop thinking about the spectacle that unfolded before my very own eyes!

text_block_list.name: Novelist
text_block_list.text: Brian! Tell me more about yourself… and that strength of yours!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Tch. No thanks. You're interfering with my running.

text_block_list.name: Novelist
text_block_list.text: Oh, c'mon… P-please, Trainer! Tell me something about the source of that unrelenting drive…
choice_data_list: Stick around and see for yourself.

text_block_list.name: Novelist
text_block_list.text: I see! Her stride—the very way she sets down her feet—has tremendous power about it as well!

text_block_list.name: Novelist
text_block_list.text: The picture's coming together now! "Her arms lift great trees, her legs split the earth…"

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I'm not dealing with this. I'm going to keep training.

text_block_list.name: Novelist
text_block_list.text: Ooohhh! "She runs off, looking like an eagle hunting its prey!"
The novelist was clearly excited, but I get a message a few days later notifying me he has given up the project because he doesn't have the craft to do Narita Brian justice.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: What? No—

text_block_list.name: Novelist
text_block_list.text: I see… Okay, I'll stick with it! A masterpiece like this is only possible through persistent reporting!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Tch, what a pain. I'm going to run my laps around the academy grounds, as planned.

text_block_list.name: Novelist
text_block_list.text: Oh! Wait a minute! If you're going to do that, I'll follow after you in my car, and when you take a break…

text_block_list.name: Novelist
text_block_list.text: Wh-when is she going to stop?! Could it be that this stamina is the source of her drive?!
Narita Brian gives me an earful afterward. Still, all that running away from the novelist was good training.
